statement: CI does not subscribe to pull-request edited events and keeps plain required check names. The separate Base retarget workflow always computes Base retarget / fresh CI required on opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft, labeled, unlabeled and edited, including drafts. Bases outside ci.yml's pull_request branch filter (main and devel) fail closed, and a source-contract test pins the script's allowed bases to the filter. CI-triggering events supply event-base evidence; edited events compare the event base against the newest ci.yml pull_request run for the head and pull request using pull_requests[].base.ref. Missing run/base metadata, incomplete API pages and API failures fail closed; title/body edits cannot clear a mismatch. Immediately before any successful verdict, a live pull-request lookup must match the event number, base.ref and head.sha; stale reruns after retargets or pushes, missing responses and malformed responses fail closed and require CI to be re-triggered. The check records base and head, reads only a sparse checkout of the base revision, uses read-only Actions, contents and pull-request permissions, and serializes running guards per pull request with cancel-in-progress false. GitHub may replace pending runs and does not guarantee ordering; the final live check prevents stale success even when an old event finishes last. A missing base-revision script fails. Fresh CI requires opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft, labeled or unlabeled; rerunning a previous-base run retains its old payload. The context is not yet required; the owner adds it to the ruleset separately after this lands. Windows validation retains same-repository windows-proof admission and full native producers. Registered offline regressions cover base matching, fail-closed evidence, API pagination, every subscribed event and draft state, static naming, trusted checkout, branch-filter parity, pinned concurrency and read-only permissions. Hosted check publication remains pending qualification.
